headline: Indian Stocks Surge to Record Weekly Gains Amid Regional Tech Slump
summary: Indian equities rallied on Friday, defying a broader Asian equity slide to post their biggest weekly gains in nearly six years, supported by sustained foreign fund inflows.
why: Divergence between local market drivers and regional trends can highlight alternative capital allocation destinations for international investors.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Strong domestic buying and foreign inflows drove benchmark Indian indices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Sustained foreign fund inflows and investor diversification away from concentrated AI plays propelled Indian markets upward.
